question: What is the time period of the Eleventh five-year plan in India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**2007 - 2012**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **The Eleventh Five-Year Plan** was implemented in India from **2007 to 2012**.
 
• This plan aimed at achieving faster and more inclusive growth.
 
• The focus areas included poverty reduction, education, health, infrastructure, and environmental sustainability.
 
• It was the penultimate plan under the Planning Commission, which was later replaced by the NITI Aayog in 2015.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Five-Year Plans** in India were centralized and integrated national economic programs.
 
• The concept was borrowed from the Soviet Union, and the first plan was launched in 1951.
 
• These plans aimed at utilizing the country's resources efficiently to achieve set economic goals.
 
• The **Planning Commission** was responsible for the formulation and implementation of these plans until it was dissolved in 2014.
 
• The **Twelfth Five-Year Plan** (2012-2017) was the last one before the Planning Commission was replaced by the NITI Aayog.
